lines.text: Plastic cups are a one-night stand: ten minutes with you, then the bin. Vietnam dumps over three million tonnes of plastic every year.
Many students own a bottle. But why bring it? There's no reward, and no proof it matters.
Meet One Cup. Tag your cup. Tap it at the counter. Get rewarded.
Step one: stick a One Cup tag on any cup you own. Scan it with your phone, and it's yours.
Step two: buy a drink, and tap your cup on the reader. One second later: checked in, with a discount.
Step three: the app adds your points, your streak, and the plastic you saved. Points become free drinks.
Step four: every tap is verified, and counted only once. So the campus sees exactly how much plastic it saves.
Who pays? Canteens subscribe: reused cups save them money. Brands sponsor rewards. Students buy tags.
If one in ten new students joins, that's eight million fewer plastic cups, every year.
And it already works. It's ready for any campus, café or office.
One Cup. Your cup, no drama.
